title: The Enhancement and Standardization of Climate-Related Disclosures for Investors (SEC Release 33-11275)
evidence: Federal Register API for 2024-05137: "Effective date: These final rules are effective on May 28, 2024." https://www.federalregister.gov/api/v1/documents/2024-05137.json
notes: Effective on paper 2024-05-28 but stayed, so no compliance date has run. Status on 2026-11-01 is in status_note.
status_note: Read from the Federal Register on 2026-11-01. The SEC stayed the Final Rules on 2024-04-04 pending Eighth Circuit review; FR doc 2024-07648 (89 FR 25804, 2024-04-12): "the effective date of the Final Rules ... is delayed indefinitely". The Eighth Circuit held Iowa v. SEC, No. 24-1522 in abeyance on 2025-09-12. The SEC proposed rescission (FR doc 2026-11091, 91 FR 33296, 2026-06-03, comments close 2026-08-03): "the Final Rules remain stayed". sec.gov refused scripts (403) and the court docket was not opened; both facts come from the Federal Register text.

title: California Climate Corporate Data Accountability Act (SB 253), Health and Safety Code 38532
citation: California SB 253, Stats. 2023, ch. 382; Health & Safety Code 38532
evidence: LAW_SECTION_TBL in pubinfo_2023.zip (downloads.leginfo.legislature.ca.gov, archive dated 2024-11-25): HSC38532.20233822 history line: "Added by Stats. 2023, Ch. 382, Sec. 2.   (SB 253)   Effective January 1, 2024." Chaptered 2023-10-07 per BILL_VERSION_TBL; no urgency clause, so the Cal. Const. art. IV s.8(c) default of 1 January 2024 applies.
notes: Not enjoined. First Scope 1 and 2 reports due 2026-11-10 under the Initial Regulation (17 CCR 96070 to 96077), per the CARB program page opened 2026-11-01. Amended by SB 219 (Stats. 2024, ch. 766), operative 2025-01-01; see us-ca-sb219.
status_note: Read from CARB on 2026-11-01. Program page (https://ww2.arb.ca.gov/our-work/programs/california-corporate-greenhouse-gas-ghg-reporting-and-climate-related-financial-risk): "updating its regulatory proposal to defer the reporting deadline for entities to report Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions from August 10, 2026, to November 10, 2026", the Initial Regulation being "if approved by the Office of Administrative Law (OAL)" at 17 CCR 96070-96077. SB 253 Enforcement Notice, December 5, 2024 (CARB PDF linked from that page): CARB exercises enforcement discretion under H&S 38532(f)(2)(A) for good faith first-year scope 1 and 2 reporting. The law is not enjoined.

title: California Climate-Related Financial Risk Act (SB 261), Health and Safety Code 38533
citation: California SB 261, Stats. 2023, ch. 383; Health & Safety Code 38533
evidence: LAW_SECTION_TBL in pubinfo_2023.zip (downloads.leginfo.legislature.ca.gov, archive dated 2024-11-25): HSC38533.20233832 history line: "Added by Stats. 2023, Ch. 383, Sec. 2.   (SB 261)   Effective January 1, 2024." Chaptered 2023-10-07 per BILL_VERSION_TBL; no urgency clause, so the Cal. Const. art. IV s.8(c) default of 1 January 2024 applies.
notes: Enforcement enjoined pending appeal per the CARB advisory of 2025-12-01. The statutory first-report date (2026-01-01) has passed without enforcement. No later notice seen on the CARB program page on 2026-11-01. The Ninth Circuit docket was not opened.
status_note: CARB SB 261 Enforcement Advisory, December 1, 2025 (https://ww2.arb.ca.gov/sites/default/files/2025-12/Dec%201%20SB%20261%20Enforcement%20Advisory.pdf), opened 2026-11-01: "On November 18, 2025, the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals issued an order in Chamber of Commerce v. Sanchez, Case No. 25-5327 (9th Cir. 2025), granting an injunction against the enforcement of Senate Bill (SB) 261 ... during the pendency of appellate proceedings"; "CARB will not enforce Health and Safety Code section 38533 against covered entities for failing to post and submit reports by the January 1, 2026, statutory deadline." Whether an enjoined law counts as in force for the lookup is not decided here.

title: California SB 219 (amends Health and Safety Code 38532 and 38533)
citation: California SB 219, Stats. 2024, ch. 766; amends Health & Safety Code 38532 and 38533
evidence: BILL_VERSION_TBL_20214.lob in pubinfo_2023.zip (chaptered text): CHAPTERED and APPROVED 2024-09-27, chapter 766, ImmediateEffect NO, Urgency NO, so the Cal. Const. art. IV s.8(c) default of 1 January 2025 applies. CARB Enforcement Notice of 2024-12-05: "On September 27, 2024, SB 219 (Wiener, Statutes of 2024, Chapter 766) amended state law to extend the date for CARB to adopt the regulations specified in SB 253 from January 1, 2025, to July 1, 2025."
notes: The story names Stats. 2024, ch. 1038; the bulk file and CARB both give chapter 766. The record is the chaptered act text, not a codified section; kind is consolidated because the source row has only that form.
status_note: Amends both laws and is not itself enjoined. The 9th Cir. injunction concerns SB 261 (H&S 38533) enforcement; see us-ca-sb261. CARB SB 253 Enforcement Notice (2024-12-05), opened 2026-11-01, describes the amendment.
